logo.title: The Logo
logo.text: The logo combines a friendly cow illustration, fluid lettering, and an expressive graphic form. The dynamic silhouette brings personality to the brand, while soft curves create a natural and approachable feel. Purple establishes a distinctive visual identity, setting MilkKalina apart from traditional dairy packaging.

desc: MilkKalina is a self-initiated premium dairy brand concept created for the Polish market. The identity combines associations with natural freshness and traditional farm products with a contemporary visual aesthetic. From the logo to packaging for six products, the project establishes a cohesive brand language built around warmth, personality, and recognition.
deliverables: Logo, packaging for six products, collection poster
